name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support scheme for farmers providing ₹6000 per year in three equal installments
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers with cultivable land up to 2 hectares
benefits: ₹6000 per year paid in three installments of ₹2000 each directly to bank account
application_process: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in or visit nearest Common Service Center

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Credit facility for farmers to meet their agricultural and allied activities requirements
eligibility: All farmers including tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers
benefits: Flexible credit limit, low interest rates (7% per annum), crop insurance coverage
application_process: Apply at any bank branch with required documents
contact: Contact nearest bank branch or call banking helpline

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers in case of crop failure
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
benefits: Premium subsidy up to 90%, coverage for pre-sowing to post-harvest losses
application_process: Apply through banks, CSCs, or insurance companies within cutoff dates

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides soil health cards to farmers with recommendations for nutrient management
benefits: Free soil testing, customized fertilizer recommendations, improved crop productivity
application_process: Contact local agriculture extension officer or soil testing laboratory

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
description: Promotes organic farming through cluster-based approach and certification
eligibility: Farmers willing to adopt organic farming practices in clusters of 50 acres
benefits: ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years, organic certification support, market linkage
application_process: Apply through State Agriculture Department or implementing agencies

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
description: Promotes efficient water use through micro-irrigation systems
eligibility: All categories of farmers with water source and cultivable land
benefits: Subsidy up to 55% for micro-irrigation systems, water conservation
application_process: Apply through State Agriculture Department or online portal
contact: Contact District Collector or Agriculture Department

name: Minimum Support Price (MSP)
description: Government procurement of crops at predetermined minimum prices
eligibility: Farmers growing MSP crops in procurement areas
benefits: Guaranteed minimum price for 23 crops, direct procurement by government agencies
application_process: Register at nearest procurement center during procurement season
contact: Contact local FCI office or procurement center

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
description: Promotes farm mechanization through subsidies on agricultural equipment
eligibility: All categories of farmers, priority to SC/ST, women farmers, and small farmers
benefits: Subsidy 40-50% on tractors and implements, custom hiring centers
application_process: Apply through State Agriculture Department or online portal

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
description: Promotes holistic growth of horticulture sector including fruits, vegetables, spices
eligibility: Individual farmers, groups, cooperatives, companies engaged in horticulture
benefits: Subsidy for planting material, protected cultivation, post-harvest management

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
description: Provides guaranteed wage employment for rural households
eligibility: Rural households willing to do unskilled manual work
benefits: 100 days guaranteed employment per household per year, minimum wage payment
application_process: Apply at Gram Panchayat office or online
contact: Contact Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office
